important_limits: V1/V2/V3 failed gates and evidence remain byte unchanged.
All four science domains are now previously seen; only the retail-held source partition and independently authored language are new for v4.
The language author did not execute a router on the held file; the routing owner did not read its contents before freeze.
The source values are written before hidden reads; this is not unseen-fact prediction.
UTF8 bytes are read from trained factors without an answer-class dictionary; high rank may cost more than strong ordinary compression.
Learned affine coefficients use supplied function families and tensor types; multiplication/calendar operations and type catalogs are supplied.
No full production integration, universal type invention, universal compression or complete weight unlearning is claimed.
Every empirical blocker remains open unless its predeclared actual gate passes; sealed failure is not a scientific success.
Typed maintenance is a separate versioned-owner experiment; the joint language study reuses an immutable transfer artifact and does not claim live production integration.
